notes.title: EA version update instructions on February 2, 2024
notes.content: 1. Fix bugs in novice guidance interface

notes.title: EA Version Update Notes for January 31, 2024:
EA Version Update Notes for January 30, 2024:
EA version update instructions on January 26, 2024
notes.content:
1. Preliminary support for SteamDeck. Currently, the in-game UI needs to be controlled by a touch screen. In the next few days, the game controller UI will be supported;
2. Adjusted the UI settings of the main interface

notes.title: EA version update on January 27, 2024:
notes.content:
Adjusted the feel of blocking, now the activation feels crisper.
Revised the stamina consumption strategy, making it more balanced overall.
Moderately nerfed the female orc boss in the second level.
Fixed the issue where the archer boss in the third level frequently shot arrows from off-screen.
Corrected texture errors in certain scenes of the second level.

notes.title: EA version update instructions on January 26, 2024
notes.content: 1. Fixed the bug that caused the player to get stuck when the female orc boss releases a landing slash in the second level.
